title: Follow Lloyd's clustering updates
description: You compare distance calculations and trace assignment and centroid updates.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You compute one squared distance per observation-center pair with nested loops. Taking the dot product of diff with itself sums squared feature differences.
You define a cluster plot and sample observations around each of three stated centers. Stacking the groups creates the two-dimensional dataset.
You select initial centers from distinct rows. The active clustering loop uses broadcasting for squared distances and assigns each point to its nearest center before plotting.

steps.question: What happens to the center of an empty cluster?
steps.answer: It keeps centers[k]. A populated cluster instead receives the mean of its assigned observations.

steps.description: You stop when old and new centers are close, or finish the iteration limit. The final call returns centers and labels for K=3 using the supplied seed.
